banner.title: generic-device-plugin
banner.tagline: Advertises the host's TUN device and the B70 Arc GPU to kubelet as devic.es resources, so pods request a device instead of mounting it.

art.about: a device plugin that turns host device nodes into schedulable resources
art.title: How generic-device-plugin hands out devices

explainer.title: From a host device node to a schedulable share

steps.title: Read
steps.text: The DaemonSet reads its device groups from config.yaml, mounted read-only from a ConfigMap whose name carries a content hash.
steps.scene: a plug feeding a config card into a slot

steps.title: Match
steps.text: Each group names host paths under /dev. The B70 is matched by its PCI address, so the path survives renumbering of the kernel nodes.
steps.scene: a GPU card tagged with a PCI slot label

steps.title: Share
steps.text: Each group advertises its count as shares. Kubelet hands them out under devic.es/b70 and devic.es/b70-vaapi, two names for one card.
steps.scene: one card split into ninety-nine small tokens

steps.title: Allocate
steps.text: A pod that requests a resource receives only the device nodes mapped for that group, and nothing else.
steps.scene: a pod receiving a single labelled device node
